Desktop product state.evidence: bookmarks, favicons, omnibox, NTP, session restore, sync and translate have no web-visible surface in the inventory

General Wayland compatibility.evidence: the headed oracle runs under Tinyland remote mode with only the interfaces Tinyland advertises (headed-*.json captured there)

Privacy Sandbox implementations.evidence: privacy.json and headed-privacy.json record the exposed interfaces and their rejection behavior; Manganese keeps exactly those

Proxy and auth machinery beyond the appl.evidence: the appliance passes a fixed socks5 proxy and every connection goes through it (make contract, 6.1); PAC, WPAD and system proxy settings are unreachable. Basic and Digest auth stay

Revocation and CT enforcement.evidence: component updates are off (3.2), so Manganese matches the oracle stale-list behavior; no probe surface differs

SUID sandbox helper.evidence: no chrome_sandbox process in either mode; every renderer runs in its own user namespace with NoNewPrivs 1 and Seccomp 2 (sandbox.json, headed-sandbox.json)

Tab discarding and Memory Saver.evidence: no inventory surface; CDP-attached parked pages are exempt from discarding

XSLT.evidence: XSLTProcessor transforms in headless, headed (xslt.json, headed-xslt.json)
